runtimeState.reason: R1369 is a Local public/member-workspace trust and accessibility refinement using the already-qualified runtime APIs.

materialChanges: Fail-closed public action-link rendering now permits only http/https addresses before a resident-facing link is shown.
Internal promotion/media state tokens are translated into plain English/Spanish member-facing labels and unknown states fail closed to neutral copy.
Promotion/event previews now include a non-approval details check for missing resident-facing dates, locations and action links.
Dynamic media preview/remove/replace actions now expose aria-expanded, aria-busy, focus movement and polite screen-reader announcements.
Media preview renders only expected PDF or image MIME classes and does not silently display unsupported media types.
Mobile member-preview layout remains one-column at the existing narrow breakpoint; desktop homepage hero is untouched.
preservedRules: Free claim, factual correction, removal and basic profile management remain free.
Community Membership remains optional and pricing is unchanged.
No payment buys factual truth or verification.
No guaranteed traffic, ranking, lead, customer, sale, booking or revenue claims.
Local does not authorize or send outreach.
Profile Factory remains canonical profile authority.
Desktop/laptop homepage hero presentation remains unchanged.
